treatment_summary: Add low‑dose ramipril and atorvastatin to achieve blood pressure and lipid targets per NICE CG181/NG28. Initiate metformin (contingent on normal renal function) and semaglutide for weight management and diabetes prevention. Continue amlodipine, use paracetamol for pain, and arrange baseline labs, QRISK calculation, and lifestyle interventions (diet, exercise, diabetes prevention programme). Monitor BP, renal function, electrolytes, lipids, HbA1c, and weight at scheduled intervals.
